runs.text: The review does not report a cycle life (cycles to a capacity threshold) for the oxyfluoride Li2Mn2/3Nb1/3O2F. It describes the material only as a DRX oxyfluoride; the text says it "relies on the Mn redox center" for its capacity, and the figure caption names it.

The only cycling data for this compound is in panel a of the figure whose caption names it. That panel's inset plots capacity against cycle number over a short window only, with no stated endpoint at any capacity threshold.

support.quote: Figure 9. Charge/discharge profiles of various DRX cathodes including a) Li2Mn2/3Nb1/3O2F

runs.text: So the document contains no cycle-life value for this material to report.
